verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document card restrictions by category, merchant, or amount, nor any auto-lock or decline of out-of-policy spend at the point of sale. The closest items are adjacent: MCP card-status lookup (active/inactive), MCP questions about 'flag/decline reasons,' and generic 'policy and approval workflows,' none of which shows configurable card controls or real-time enforcement.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can restrict cards by category, merchant, and amount — and the platform auto-locks or declines out-of-policy spend at the point of sale
